headline: Broadcom clocking-design role calls for MSV and RNM strategies in PLL, FLL, and DLL verification
fact: Broadcom posted a Digital Mixed-Signal Lead role for the digital control infrastructure of PLL, FLL, and DLL clocking subsystems. The description assigns partnership with verification teams to drive mixed-signal-verification and real-number-modeling strategies for high-coverage loop simulations and also names full-chip CDC and RDC sign-off for the clocking network. This is evidence of a public hiring mandate, not proof that the listed verification strategies were already deployed across Broadcom.

sources.title: Broadcom Careers: Mixed Signal Digital Design Lead (R026040)
sources.summary: The official Broadcom Workday record exposes a June 30, 2026 start date and describes the PLL/FLL/DLL digital-control, MSV/RNM verification-partnership, and full-chip CDC/RDC scope.
